I am a **post-doctoral researcher** in Economics at Sciences Po, specifically working at [AxPo](https://www.sciencespo.fr/axpo/) and affiliated to the [Department of Economics](https://www.sciencespo.fr/department-economics/). Before that, I obtained my PhD at [EHESS](https://www.ehess.fr/fr/) in 2026.

My work is predominantly in labor economics and applied econometrics. In particular, I am interested in topics related to **working hours**, from the measurement of hours worked to their impact on labor market dynamics and broader economic issues.

Most of my research also involves linking survey and administrative data to combine rich sets of variables with panel data structure.
